items.title: Product Designer, Accessibility
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Design Systems team creates the foundations that help teams across OpenAI build coherent, high-quality experiences at scale. Accessibility is fundamental to that work. We’re building the shared standards, components, tools, and practices that make inclusive experiences the default across OpenAI’s products and platforms. About the Role In this role, you’ll lead OpenAI’s company-wide accessibility program from within the Design Foundations team within Product Design. You’ll pair strategy and organizational influence with hands-on product design (visual and interaction design) —advocating for disabled people, removing barriers across complete customer journeys, and establishing durable ownership throughout the company. This is an opportunity to define accessibility for a new generation of products spanning web, mobile, desktop, voice, AI, and hardware. You’ll help teams consider the many ways people perceive, understand, navigate, and interact with technology, going beyond minimum compliance to create experiences that are genuinely useful and inclusive. Working across design, engineering, research, product, go-to-market, and legal, you’ll make accessibility an expected part of product quality—not a final review or the responsibility of a single expert. This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role you will: - Design and ship product experiences while identifying systemic barriers across complete customer journeys. - Define OpenAI’s accessibility strategy, roadmap, governance, priorities, and measures of progress. - Build accessibility into our design system through inclusive components, tokens, interaction patterns, Figma libraries, documentation, and engineering guardrails. - Center disabled people through participatory research, usability studies, and assistive-technology testing rather than relying solely on assumptions, simulations, or automated tools. - Design for permanent, temporary, and situational disabilities, including multiple ways to perceive information, navigate interfaces, understand content, and complete important tasks. - Establish practical standards for screen readers, keyboard navigation, focus, reading order, contrast, typography, motion, captions, forms, errors, and multimodal interactions. - Lead accessibility audits, remediation priorities, launch readiness, and continuous validation across platforms. - Partner with go-to-market, legal, compliance, and product teams on enterprise readiness, accessibility documentation, procurement needs, and customer commitments. - Grow company-wide capability through training, critiques, engineering partnerships, and a network of accessibility champions. You might thrive in this role if you: - Pair deep accessibility expertise with a very high bar for design craft: strong interaction design, visual design, systems thinking, and prototyping skills - Have led accessibility or inclusive-design work across multiple teams, products, or platforms. - Understand the relationship between accessibility, usability, and inclusive design—and know when to go beyond standards to meet real human needs. - Have deep practical knowledge of WCAG, assistive technologies, accessible interaction design, and platform-specific standards. - Have embedded accessibility into design systems, reusable components, and engineering workflows. - Have worked directly with disabled people and translated their experiences into meaningful product and organizational decisions. - Can identify assumptions and exclusion within a product journey, then turn those insights into clearer and more flexible ways to interact. - Are equally effective setting strategy, designing detailed experiences, and collaborating with engineers through implementation. - Can influence across disciplines without direct authority, creating shared accountability without becoming a centralized approval gate. items.title: Mechanical Design Engineer, Motor Design & Prototyping
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a Mechanical Design Engineer to lead the development of motor mechanical designs and prototype hardware for advanced robotic systems. You will own stator and rotor mechanical development from early concepts and detailed design through hands-on builds and prototype validation, partnering closely with electromagnetic, electrical, test, and manufacturing teams. This role focuses on the design, integration, and validation of motor components and prototype processes, including laminations, stack assemblies, bobbins, winding interfaces, and fixtures. You will help drive motor development from initial design through repeatable low-volume builds while establishing the tooling, work instructions, and validation practices needed for future robotic platforms. This role is based in San Francisco, CA, and requires in-person presence 4 days a week. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Own stator and rotor mechanical designs and released CAD and drawings, including geometry, interfaces, fits, tolerances, retention, assembly access, and mechanical validation. - Develop laminations, stack assembly methods, bobbins, and winding interfaces that control alignment, insulation, conductor placement, and end-turn packaging. - Design, fabricate, and debug fixtures for winding, stacking, assembly, alignment, and inspection. - Build and troubleshoot prototypes. Use measurements, defects, rework, and assembly effort to improve designs and processes. - Establish low-volume prototype production with equipment, build sequences, work instructions, revision control, traceability, and acceptance checks that let technicians reproduce successful builds. - Test new manufacturing methods and winding approaches, balancing performance, repeatability, and practical implementation. - Work with electromagnetic, electrical, manufacturing, and test engineers to resolve tradeoffs between motor performance, packaging, buildability, and validation. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Move comfortably between CAD, the shop, measurements, and hands-on builds, and take ownership of the physical result. - Understand how tolerances, insulation, tool access, and assembly sequence affect whether a motor can be built and used reliably. - Diagnose failed builds through evidence and focused experiments, then carry the fix into the next iteration. - Build useful processes while designs evolve, and document them so others can reproduce the result. - Communicate assumptions and tradeoffs clearly and resolve coupled problems across disciplines. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience designing and building motors, actuators, or other precision electromechanical assemblies. - Experience with lamination stacks, bobbins, winding, insulation interfaces, or small-component assembly. - Proficiency in 3D CAD, manufacturing drawings, tolerance analysis, and fixture design, with hands-on metrology and inspection of critical mechanical interfaces. - Machining, additive manufacturing, bonding, or other prototype manufacturing processes. - Experience turning an initial build into a repeatable low-volume process. - Interest in using AI to reduce repetitive design and prototype work, with careful engineering review. items.title: Senior Legal Counsel - Privacy
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE The LeoVegas Mobile Gaming Group is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Legal Counsel focused on privacy, to join our dynamic and growing Privacy team. This is a pivotal role within the organisation, instrumental in safeguarding the personal data of our customers and employees, and ensuring robust data protection practices across our diverse brands, entities, and markets. You will play a leading role in the strategic development and operational implementation of our privacy program, with the opportunity of exploring more general legal and regulatory affairs focused matters, as necessary. YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - As Senior Legal Counsel - Privacy, your core duties will include, but are not limited to: - Take responsibility for ensuring compliance with all privacy related laws and regulations for assigned entities, brands, and markets within the LeoVegas Mobile Gaming Group. - Serve as Data Protection Officer (DPO) for designated Group entities, fulfilling all statutory duties and responsibilities associated with the role, ensuring compliance with relevant data protection laws and regulations. - Collaborate closely with other DPOs and internal stakeholders on all pertinent data protection matters, contributing to a cohesive and effective privacy framework. - Conduct comprehensive data protection due diligence on prospective and existing business partners - Draft, review, and negotiate complex data protection agreements, clauses, and terms. - Draft, review, and update privacy policies and related procedures, privacy notices, and cookie policies for the Group and its partners, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and legal compliance. - Develop and refine internal procedures and policies to ensure robust personal data protection and GDPR compliance across all business operations. - Provide expert legal advice and guidance on a broad spectrum of data protection issues to various business units, senior management, and project teams. - Actively participate in and lead data protection workstreams within significant company projects, including mergers & acquisitions (M&As), ensuring privacy by design and by default principles are integrated from inception. - Take ownership of and lead major privacy-related initiatives, representing the Privacy team in critical cross-functional company projects and steering groups. - Mentor junior team members and contribute significantly to the professional development and knowledge sharing within the Privacy team, fostering a culture of continuous learning. - Contribute strategically to the evolution and implementation of the Group's overall privacy program and strategy, aligning with business objectives and regulatory landscapes. - Provide assistance and legal advice concerning data subjects' rights requests, ensuring timely and compliant responses. - Manage and provide expert advice on customer complaints related to data protection, including conducting thorough internal investigations, drafting submission, and preparing comprehensive reports. - Liaise effectively with data protection supervisory authorities and other regulators regarding complaints, inquiries, audits, and other regulatory matters. - Handle any data breaches and associated reporting requirements in a timely and compliant manner; - Ensure that material data protection risks are escalated appropriately and that regulatory reporting obligations are discharged within statutory timeframes. - Conduct, manage, advise on, and assist with Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), other privacy related assessments or investigations, and privacy audits, identifying risks and recommending mitigation strategies. OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: ESSENTIAL SKILLS - A recognised legal qualification demonstrating a strong foundation in legal principles and analysis. - A minimum of 4-6 years of progressive experience in a dedicated privacy legal role, preferably within a multinational or complex corporate environment. - Deep and demonstrable expertise in GDPR and other relevant global data protection laws. - Proven experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex data protection agreements and privacy-related policies. - Demonstrated ability to act as a DPO or hold a similar lead privacy advisory role, including managing regulatory interactions. - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical business solutions. - Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to advise and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation. - Ability to work autonomously, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and evolving regulatory landscape. - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. NICE TO HAVES - Specific experience within the iGaming, financial services, or technology sectors is considered a very strong asset due to the inherent data intensity and regulatory scrutiny. - Any relevant privacy certifications. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide. BENEFITS - Hybrid working - 3 days per week at the office, with flexibility for 2 days at home - Workation – Take your job on an adventure with our Workation benefit for up to 4 weeks per year (T&Cs apply). - Plenty of time to recharge – 28 days of paid leave, plus all public and bank holidays in England. - Invest in your future – We match pension contributions up to 6%. - Comprehensive healthcare – BUPA coverage, including pre-existing conditions, plus a cashback plan for dental, optical, and other treatments. - Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply). - A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, complimentary snacks and drinks, as well as breakfasts and lunches on a weekly basis - A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun. - Support for growing families – Up to 6 months of full pay for maternity leave. - Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts to keep you moving. - Work in style – at our newly renovated offices at Tailors Corner are just a 2-minute walk from Leeds Train Station. - And there’s more… We’ll share even more perks related to your role when you chat with our Talent Acquisition team! JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

items.title: Product Owner - Sportsbook
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About UXMatrix UXMatrix develops a broad range of digital products, including bespoke frontend applications, reusable templates, widgets, APIs, automated quality-assurance solutions, and a fully customizable WordPress-based CMS. Our products serve multiple operators, brands, and regulated markets, requiring us to balance customer needs, end-user experience, technical scalability, regulatory requirements, and commercial value. About the Role We are looking for a Sportsbook Product Owner to join the UXMatrix Product Team and take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of our sportsbook frontend experience. You will define what should be built and why, translating customer, market, and business needs into clear product outcomes and actionable requirements for the development team. You will work closely with design, engineering, QA, delivery, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, and operators throughout the complete product lifecycle—from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization. The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking with an understanding of sportsbook user journeys, frontend technology, data, and agile delivery. You should be comfortable making decisions, challenging assumptions, managing competing priorities, and maintaining a clear product direction in a fast-paced environment. What You'll get to do: Product Vision and Strategy Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, objectives, and roadmap for the sportsbook frontend. Translate company strategy, operator requirements, market trends, and end-user needs into clear product priorities. Identify opportunities to improve sportsbook acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall user experience. Balance reusable product capabilities with operator-specific and market-specific requirements. Contribute to the long-term evolution of the sportsbook product, including personalization, modularity, scalability, and multi-tenant capabilities. Clearly articulate the business and customer value behind proposed initiatives. Product Discovery and Requirements Work with operators, commercial teams, internal stakeholders, and end users to identify problems, needs, and product opportunities. Analyze sportsbook journeys such as event discovery, navigation, search, market selection, bet placement, betslip usage, live betting, promotions, and bet management. Convert business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. Break down complex initiatives into manageable and independently deliverable increments. Validate requirements with design, engineering, QA, platform teams, and relevant stakeholders before development begins. Ensure regulatory, responsible-gambling, accessibility, localization, and market-specific requirements are considered during product definition. Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible product documentation in Jira and Confluence. Roadmap and Prioritization Own and continuously maintain the product backlog. Prioritize initiatives and backlog items based on customer value, user impact, commercial potential, strategic alignment, risk, effort, and technical dependencies. Define minimum viable product scope and phased-delivery approaches for larger initiatives. Manage scope throughout the delivery lifecycle and ensure material changes are assessed, documented, and agreed with the appropriate stakeholders. Balance new product development, operator requirements, technical improvements, defects, and technical-debt reduction. Make clear prioritization decisions when capacity or timelines are constrained. Agile Delivery Work closely with engineering, design, and QA throughout planning, refinement, development, testing, and release. Ensure the development team understands the product objectives, user needs, requirements, and expected outcomes. Lead or actively contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and relevant product workshops. Provide timely clarification and make product decisions during development. Identify dependencies, risks, and blockers early and collaborate with the appropriate owners to resolve them. Accept completed work based on agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support release planning and ensure features are ready from a product, operational, documentation, and stakeholder perspective. Maintain delivery transparency and communicate progress, risks, scope changes, and decisions clearly. Stakeholder and Client Management Act as the primary product contact for assigned sportsbook initiatives. Build strong working relationships with operators, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, engineering, UX, QA, delivery, and senior management. Facilitate product workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, demonstrations, and roadmap discussions. Set clear expectations regarding product scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery assumptions. Evaluate stakeholder requests objectively and challenge solutions that do not support the product strategy or provide sufficient customer value. Present recommendations using evidence, product data, competitive analysis, and clearly structured business arguments. Support client presentations, product demonstrations, sales opportunities, and RFP responses when required. Product Performance and Continuous Improvement Define success criteria and measurable KPIs for new features and product initiatives. Monitor sportsbook metrics such as event-to-bet conversion, betslip completion, bet placement success, click-through rates, engagement, bet frequency, retention, and feature adoption. Use quantitative data, qualitative feedback, user research, and operational insights to evaluate product performance. Review delivered features after launch and identify opportunities for optimization. Work with UX and analytics teams to identify friction, abandonment points, usability issues, and unmet customer needs. Maintain awareness of sportsbook market developments, competitor products, user-experience patterns, and emerging technologies. Conduct competitor and feature-comparison analysis to identify meaningful product differentiators. Propose improvements that strengthen the UXMatrix sportsbook proposition and create measurable value for EveryMatrix clients. What we’re looking for: At least three years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, or a comparable digital-product role. Experience in iGaming. Experience working with cross-functional software-development teams in an agile environment. Strong ability to translate business and user needs into clear, structured, and testable product requirements. Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, priorities, scope, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make evidence-based product decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Confidence presenting product recommendations and reasoning with technical, commercial, and senior stakeholders. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities. Ability to understand technical concepts, frontend architecture, APIs, integrations, and platform dependencies at a product level. Experience using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent product and delivery-management tools. Professional proficiency in English. A degree in technology, economics, business, or a related discipline. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means establishing a clear and evidence-based direction for the sportsbook frontend, maintaining a well-prioritized and delivery-ready backlog, improving collaboration between product and engineering, and delivering measurable improvements for operators and sportsbook users. You will be expected to create alignment around what we build, why we build it, and how we determine whether it has been successful. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Engineering Manager, International
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The International engineering team's mission is to expand Robinhood's products globally and scale our platform to support millions of new customers in diverse markets. We build and maintain experiences across onboarding, funding, account setup, localized product experiences, growth incentives, and platform capabilities to operate in new jurisdictions. Our engineering team partners closely with product, design, compliance, marketing teams, along with an array of platform engineering teams to launch new products and optimize user acquisition globally. We prioritize technical rigor, system reliability, and quick execution to deliver reliable products to our growing customer base. Our culture is centered on clear communication, strong team partnership, and a commitment to helping people manage their financial lives! As an Engineering Manager , you will lead a team of software developers to drive some of Robinhood’s most important international launch initiatives. You will be responsible for driving the architecture and execution required to launch crypto and other financial products in new regions, while shaping the reusable systems that make future launches faster, safer, and more scalable. You will guide technical execution, review system architectures, and ensure our services remain highly performant and secure at scale. In this role, you will recruit, mentor, and support the career progression of engineers on your team. You will work closely with product managers, compliance partners, and other team leads to define technical strategy and deliver features on schedule. Your leadership will directly shape how we scale our platform and deliver a reliable financial experience to our global community! This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week . At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Team Leadership & Development: Lead and support your team of developers, providing clear goals, regular feedback, and structured growth plans. Technical Strategy: Define technical direction and prioritize work with product managers and partner teams to scale our international products and systems. Architecture & Performance: Ensure backend services and localized products are designed for high availability, performance, and security. Talent Management: Manage hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations for engineers on your team. Collaboration & Execution: Coordinate with product, design, and other engineering leads to deliver critical initiatives on schedule and meet defined business metrics. What you bring Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years of experience managing engineering teams. Product Shipping Experience: Proven experience leading collaborative teams across product, design, and engineering to ship complex products, including end-to-end management from concept to launch, and ensuring high-quality, reliable user experiences post-deployment. Systems Design: Experience designing and operating distributed systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance. Project Delivery: Experience delivering complex technical projects from initial planning through execution and deployment. Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business partners to explain technical decisions and trade-offs. Mentorship: Experience supporting team development through regular coaching, mentoring, and feedback. Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. items.title: Product Data Analyst – User Behavior & Analytics
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About the Role We are looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the UXMatrix Product Team and help establish a consistent, evidence-based approach to product development and optimization. You will define how product performance and user behaviour are measured, ensure that the necessary data is collected accurately, and transform that data into insights and recommendations that Product Owners, UX Designers, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders can act upon. This role extends beyond dashboard creation and regular reporting. You will investigate user journeys, identify friction and opportunities, support product discovery, define feature-success criteria, and determine whether released initiatives achieve their intended customer and business outcomes. You will work across UXMatrix products, with a particular focus on critical frontend journeys such as registration, login, deposit, sportsbook navigation, event discovery, bet placement, casino discovery, promotions, content interaction, and customer retention. What You'll get to do: Product Measurement Strategy Work with Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business objectives into measurable product outcomes and KPIs. Establish clear success criteria before features and initiatives enter development. Define leading and lagging indicators across acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and feature adoption. Help product teams distinguish between activity metrics, diagnostic metrics, and measurable customer or business outcomes. Ensure product recommendations are supported by reliable data, user research, or clearly documented hypotheses. Analytics Tracking and Data Quality Define and maintain analytics tracking plans for websites, applications, widgets, and critical user journeys. Translate business questions and measurement objectives into clear technical tracking requirements. Validate analytics implementations before and after release. Monitor data quality and investigate broken events, incomplete parameters, unexpected changes, and reporting discrepancies. Ensure that tracking implementations comply with consent, privacy, security, and applicable regulatory requirements. Product and User-Behaviour Analysis Identify abandonment points, friction, behavioural patterns, and opportunities for improvement. Segment users according to relevant characteristics such as acquisition source, device, market, lifecycle stage, product preference, engagement level, or previous behaviour. Conduct funnel, cohort, retention, conversion, path, and behavioural analyses. Analyze critical user journeys Combine quantitative data with UX research, customer feedback, technical performance, and operational context. Reporting and Data Visualization Build and maintain dashboards that provide stakeholders with a clear view of product performance. Create reporting views appropriate for Product Owners, UX teams, Engineering teams, operators, commercial stakeholders, and senior management. Present trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities clearly and concisely. Reduce dependency on manual reporting by developing reusable and automated dashboards. Ensure KPI definitions remain consistent across products, teams, and reports. Deliver focused analysis and actionable recommendations rather than reporting data without interpretation. Product Discovery and Decision Support Support Product Owners during product discovery by evaluating evidence, sizing opportunities, and identifying behavioural problems. Provide data to support roadmap prioritization, business cases, and investment decisions. Help product teams formulate measurable hypotheses for proposed product changes. Challenge assumptions and stakeholder requests when they are not supported by evidence or a clearly defined customer problem. Conduct market, benchmark, and competitor analyses when relevant to product decisions. Contribute relevant data and insights to product reviews, client presentations, RFP responses, and strategic discussions. Experimentation and Feature Evaluation Define hypotheses, success metrics, guardrail metrics, and evaluation criteria for product experiments. Support A/B tests, controlled rollouts, phased releases, and other product-validation methods. Conduct post-launch reviews to determine whether delivered features achieved their intended outcomes. Track whether recommendations lead to product changes and measurable improvements. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with Product Owners, UX Designers, Developers, QA Engineers, Architects, BI teams, operators, and commercial stakeholders. Facilitate workshops to define business questions, KPIs, success criteria, and tracking requirements. Proactively identify relevant insights rather than working exclusively from reporting requests. Establish a regular product-insight cadence through reviews, reporting, and focused deep-dive analyses. Keep stakeholders informed about measurement gaps, data-quality risks, and significant product-performance changes. What we’re looking for: At least three years of experience in product analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or a comparable analytical role. Previous experience in sportsbook, iGaming, gaming, fintech, e-commerce, or another transactional or regulated digital industry. Strong SQL skills and experience extracting, combining, validating, and analyzing data from multiple sources. Experience analyzing digital-product behaviour, including user journeys, conversion, engagement, feature adoption, and retention. Experience defining analytics events, parameters, tracking plans, event taxonomies, and measurement frameworks. Practical experience with analytics and visualization tools such as GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or equivalent platforms. Ability to transform complex data into clear findings and actionable product recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data quality and validation. Experience collaborating with Product, UX, Engineering, QA, BI, and commercial teams. Good understanding of web and mobile application behaviour, including client-side and server-side tracking. Professional proficiency in English. A degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics, business, or another relevant discipline. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Compute Solution Architect, you will support our strategic AI Infrastructure customers. In this role, you will be a trusted technical advisor, helping clients design, deploy, and scale AI solutions while managing large-scale GPU workloads involving thousands of GPUs. You will also collaborate with sales and product teams to drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your responsibilities will include: - Serve as the primary technical point of contact, troubleshooting and resolving for AI Infrastructure services. - Lead the delivery of strategic GPUaaS contracts and ensure all commitments are met (timelines, SLAs, support, …). - Act as a bridge to product and support teams, providing customer feedback, relaying feature requests, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements. - Guide customers in optimizing GPU performance for ML training and inference workloads, ensuring seamless integration and scalability. - Partner with the sales team to identify new opportunities, promote the latest products, and deliver technical presentations. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5-10 + years in roles like Cloud Solutions Architect, Technical Account Manager, or Customer Engineer, with hands-on experience in cloud services and AI/ML workloads. - Track record as a technical pre-sales/solutions architect driving infrastructure engagements with partners through to production. - Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and advanced implementations. - Proven success driving technical engagement and technical adoption. - Working knowledge of cluster orchestration and scheduling: Slurm, Kubernetes, and batch/HPC workload management. NICE TO HAVE - Working knowledge of model training frameworks runtimes (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, Tensorflow) and Generative AI serving runtimes (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, TGI, LLM-D). - Proficiency with parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, GPFS) and object storage integration. - Familiarity with high-performance infrastructure: InfiniBand/RDMA networking, parallel storage, and multi-node distributed training topologies. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Compute deals require flawless execution from the initial technical commitment through deployment and production. By coordinating customers, sales, product, and support, the Compute Solution Architect ensures that infrastructure performs as expected, contractual commitments and SLAs are met, and issues are resolved quickly. This end-to-end ownership is critical to building customer trust, securing long-term adoption, and turning strategic GPUaaS contracts into successful partnerships. HIRING PROCESS - Talent Acquisition screening call - 45 min Hiring Manager & Business Acumen interview - 60 min Technical deep dive - Panel (home prep & restitution) - 30 min Value talk - Reference checks WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tokenization
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Tokenization team's mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. We work at the intersection of blockchain technology, financial market infrastructure, and modern distributed systems - with a focus on accessibility, security, and scalability. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; we're building the infrastructure that changes that. As a Senior Software Engineer , you will design and build the core systems that issue, custody, and settle tokenized equities on-chain and keep them in sync with traditional brokerage and ledger systems. You'll lead technically complex projects end to end, make architectural decisions on a foundational Robinhood initiative, and work in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable - the systems you build move real customer assets, continuously, across multiple chains and jurisdictions. This role is based in our Toronto, ON office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week . At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Design, build, and operate the backend services that mint, custody, and settle tokenized equities across leading blockchains, with correctness and auditability as hard requirements Own large, technically complex projects end to end - design, implementation, rollout, and operating what you ship in a 24/7 system Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows Partner with product, compliance, legal, and platform teams to turn regulatory constraints into workable system design Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship What you bring 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including a track record of delivering large-scale distributed systems in production Expertise in backend development with Go, Python, or Java, and deep familiarity with cloud-native architecture (Kafka, Postgres, Kubernetes, or equivalents) Strong instincts for correctness-critical systems - idempotency, reconciliation, and reasoning carefully about failure modes when money is at stake Demonstrated ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional projects, with the judgment to make tradeoffs and drive alignment Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction beyond your own projects Working knowledge of blockchain fundamentals - EVM, smart contracts, wallets, on-chain settlement - or a strong appetite to go deep quickly What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. If you require a specific accommodation during the application or interview process due to a physical or mental condition, please complete this Applicant Accommodation Form to notify our team. The form should only be completed if you need a specific accommodation. Applicant Accommodation Form AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Vacancy Notice: This job posting represents an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. Base Pay Range: Toronto, ON $166,000 — $195,000 CAD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Tokenization team's mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. We work at the intersection of blockchain technology, financial market infrastructure, and modern distributed systems - with a focus on accessibility, security, and scalability. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; we're building the infrastructure that changes that. As a Software Engineer , you'll build and own backend services that make tokenized equities work end to end - issuance, custody, and settlement on-chain, kept in sync with traditional brokerage and ledger systems. You'll ship product-facing features and platform capabilities in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable - the systems you build move real customer assets, continuously, around the clock. This role is based in our Toronto, ON office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Design, build, test, and deploy the backend services that mint, custody, and settle tokenized equities on the Robinhood Chain, with correctness and auditability as hard requirements Develop product-facing features and platform enhancements that meet strict correctness and scalability standards Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows Identify and implement improvements to system performance, engineering productivity, and risk reduction Collaborate closely with product, compliance, client, and platform teams to deliver impactful technical solutions What you bring 2+ years of experience in software development Expertise in backend development using languages such as Go, Python, or Java, with a solid grasp of cloud-native architectures Strong grasp of system design, data modeling, and software engineering fundamentals Care for correctness-critical systems - idempotency, reconciliation, and reasoning carefully about failure modes when money is at stake Strong ownership mindset, with a track record of delivering high-quality projects end to end in cross-functional environments Interest in blockchain fundamentals - EVM, smart contracts, wallets, on-chain settlement - or a strong appetite to go deep quickly What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. If you require a specific accommodation during the application or interview process due to a physical or mental condition, please complete this Applicant Accommodation Form to notify our team. The form should only be completed if you need a specific accommodation. Applicant Accommodation Form AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Vacancy Notice: This job posting represents an existing vacancy that we are actively seeking to fill. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed. Base Pay Range: Toronto, ON $136,000 — $160,000 CAD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Technical Recruiter, APAC
items.location_text: Singapore, Melbourne, Bangalore, Mumbai, New Delhi, Sydney
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. ROLE SUMMARY As an experienced Talent Acquisition Specialist on the APAC recruiting team, you will be instrumental in building and scaling teams at Mistral across the region - Singapore, Korea, India, Australia and Japan. You will get a wide breadth of exposure across roles, geographies, levels. Joining Mistral in APAC today means you’ll sit at the intersection of recruiting strategy and best practice execution at scale. TAs at Mistral get a seat at the table, deep influence in decision making, and are sparring partners to hiring managers. Your work will directly influence our success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional people who will drive Mistral’s growth. You will also foster a strong candidate experience to create a flywheel for our employer brand int he region. You will also help establish recruiting best practice by creating, documenting and scaling knowledge and playbooks. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Drive our hiring effort for Applied AI and Solutions, across the region, with some flexibility and open mindedness to contribute to GTM and Corporate roles, on a need basis - Partner with our tech & business hiring managers to find world-changing talent for Mistral - Own end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, interviewing, and closing candidates - Identify unique candidates who bring an entrepreneurial spirit, strong commitment and passion for success - Guide candidates through our hiring process and introducing them to the magic of working at Mistral - Develop and refine recruiting processes, tools, and documentation to improve outcomes and efficiency - Use data to diagnose process issues and propose solutions - Deliver a high-quality candidate experience in a competitive talent market - Collaborate with others to continuously raise the bar for our hiring standards - Contribute directly to defining and evolving our talent acquisition approach in APAC ABOUT YOU - 7+ years of total recruiting experience, ideally across a mix of agencies, high growth startups, and enterprise/corporate environments - Demonstrated ability to hire at high throughput at scale, and in complex environments, never compromising quality - Self-starter who is result-oriented, resourceful, innovative, intellectually curious, and who takes initiative and risks - T-shaped with deep expertise in Technical roles: FDE, SWE, MLE, Research Eng, Applied Science - Natural geek with tooling and automation, thinks in systems and scale, embraces the latest technologies, and has ideally built a thing or two - Experience in complex recruiting and autonomous hiring in outbound contexts - Experience working to recruit in highly competitive talent markets - Strong written and verbal communication - No ego and highly committed to deliver - Able and keen to jump from strategic topics to very hands-on work - Open learning mindset and fast learner, demonstrated capacity to quickly grasp new complex topics - Capability, credibility, and consultative skills to influence senior colleagues and stakeholders without authority - Organized, disciplined, and strong at project management - Comfortable working within the ambiguity of a small, growing startup with a strong desire to turn that ambiguity into a well-defined machine - Target driven, detail oriented, and approachable with the ability to prioritize and work well in an environment with competing demands - Fluent in English and experience recruiting internationally - Ideally, proficiency with Ashby, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI tools (Vibe, Claude) WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! ABOUT NORTH: North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications. WHY THIS ROLE? This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Our esteemed clients include industry leaders like RBC, Dell, and LG CNS. We are seeking engineers who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: - Lead end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout. - Partner with enterprise IT teams to assess infrastructure, security requirements, and data management practices. - Experiment at a high velocity and with a high level of quality to engage our customers and ultimately deliver solutions that exceed their expectations - Design and implement deployment strategies tailored to client needs, ensuring compliance with data privacy and security standards. - Troubleshoot and resolve deployment-related technical issues, providing timely solutions to minimize downtime. - Travel to customer premises between 20-40% YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF: - You have experience with and enjoy working directly with customers - You have experience deploying enterprise software in private/hybrid cloud environments - You have proven experience administering large-scale production Kubernetes clusters and expertise with Helm - Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and tools like Git for version control - You have strong expertise in cloud infrastructure (Azure, AWS, GCP), networking, and virtualization - You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target - You are fluent in Arabic and English IT'S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE… - Familiarity with GPU node orchestration & scheduling - You understand the intersection of GPU infrastructure, inference systems, Kubernetes, distributed systems, and performance optimization. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

items.title: Staff Engineer - Growth - Verifications
items.location_text: Brazil, Peru, Sweden, Colombia, Argentina, Romania, Malta, Slovenia, Lithuania, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Mexico, Chile, Poland, Bulgaria
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it. How We Work - We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast. - Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end. - Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed. - At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them. THE OPPORTUNITY As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied. This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows. - Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow. - Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage. - Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny. - Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good. - Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate. - Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback. - Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it. items.title: Compliance Manager
items.description: About Kambi Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our services provide an end-to-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. From front-end user interface to customer intelligence, risk management and odds compiling, all built on our in-house developed software, we strive to deliver the ultimate service and solution to our partners. Our vision is to create the world’s leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners. The team We’re looking for a Compliance Manager to join our award-winning Legal team as part of Kambi’s continued growth. You will be joining a team of nearly 30 people split across London and Malta, helping to provide support to the Kambi business globally. As a Compliance Manager, your day-to-day will look like: Manage end-to-end due diligence for new and existing clients/partners/suppliers, including intake, evidence collection, review, risk assessment, approval, recordkeeping and renewal. Monitor legal and gambling regulatory changes and provide updates to relevant stakeholders in the business. Own policy lifecycle management, including drafting, approvals, rollout, training/communications, and periodic monitoring and reviews to embed consistent controls across the business. Provide administrative support to Kambi’s Compliance Committee if/as required. Prepare and collate licensing submissions, such as forms and exhibits, to be used in gaming license application processes if/as required. Communicate and manage relationship with both regulatory authorities and key executives in the business if/as required. Support information management processes and resources related to licenses/registrations held by Kambi and update of software/systems used for managing license applications if/as required. Manage multiple projects/workstreams, prioritising in accordance with the business’ needs if/as required. Potentially manage one or more individuals within the team. You’ll be a great fit for the role if you have: Strong professional experience working within compliance/regulatory Experience with AML, ABC and Policy monitoring An AML qualification would also be highly beneficial Organised, proactive and with an excellent eye for detail Ability to work self-sufficiently and to tight deadlines on assigned tasks Strong communication skills An eagerness to learn Let’s talk about what’s in it for you? A friendly and supportive team Exposure to the global business Excellent company benefits including bonus and healthcare Hybrid working set up of 3 days in the office Kambi's ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback. Creating an inclusive environment We believe Kambi's greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today. #wearekambi

items.description: Scale’s rapidly growing International Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of: Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens Generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI As a Full Stack Software Engineer (Forward Deployed), you’ll collaborate directly with public sector counterparts to quickly build full-stack, AI applications, to solve their most pressing challenges and achieve meaningful impact for citizens. At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions—we’re enabling the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI in the public sector and be a founding member of our team, we’d love to hear from you. You will: Serve as the lead technical strategist for public sector engagements, converting ambiguous mission requirements into robust architectural roadmaps and guiding onsite implementation Architect the fundamental frameworks for production-grade AI applications, setting the gold standard for how interactive UIs, backend systems, and AI models are integrated at scale to deliver reliable outcomes. Guide the evolution of cloud infrastructure, ensuring security, global scalability, and long-term system integrity across all environments. Direct the development of core platforms and shared services, ensuring they solve cross-cutting needs for diverse global client use cases. Partner with cross-functional leadership to steer the technical roadmap, mentoring senior and junior staff and ensuring all products align with a cohesive, future-proof technical architecture. Bridge the gap between the field and the core platform by turning real-world client lessons into the reusable patterns that power the entire engineering team. Ideally you’d have: Masters or Phd in Computer Science or equivalent deep industry experience in architecting complex, distributed systems. 10+ years of full-stack expertise across Python, Node.js, and React, with a proven track record of designing high-scale architectures on Kubernetes and global cloud infrastructures (AWS/Azure/GCP). Expert ability to design and oversee production-grade ecosystems, ensuring world-class standards for system integrity, security, and long-term scalability. Extensive experience deploying and troubleshooting sophisticated end-to-end solutions directly within complex, high-security client environments. Proven track record of building LLM-driven solutions with the strategic foresight to anticipate landscape shifts and architect future-proof systems. A self-driven leader capable of resolving extreme ambiguity, mentoring senior staff, and setting the technical vision for the organization. A driver of asynchronous workflows and documentation-first cultures to streamline global engineering velocity and reduce friction. Nice to haves: Past experience working at a startup as a CTO or founding engineer or in a forward deployed engineer / dedicated customer engineer role Experience working cross functionally with operations Proficient in Arabic For those applying based in Qatar: Residency and employment in Qatar requires certain permissions (visa and permits) issued by the Qatari authorities.
